evidence_quotes.quote: Management Alternatives for River-Alluvial Groundwater Supply Systems
1Graduate Research Assistant, University of British Columbia, Department of Civil Engineering, 6250 Applied Science Lane, Vancouver, BC, V6T 1Z4, Canada

This approach is developed considering the water supply conditions for the City of Fredericton, New Brunswick; however, it may be generalized for the many similar hydrologic settings that exist in North America.
